database.routers.experiment

Experiment and discovery endpoints

Provides API for running experiments, discovering patterns, and generating recommendations

Attributes

router

Functions

create_experiment(request, manager)

Create and run a new experiment

list_experiments(session[, status])

List all experiments with optional status filter

get_experiment(experiment_id, session)

Get details of a specific experiment

list_patterns(session[, min_confidence, validated_only])

List discovered patterns with optional filtering

discover_patterns(manager[, min_confidence])

Discover new patterns from completed experiments

validate_pattern(pattern_id, validation_run_ids, session)

Mark a pattern as validated with supporting runs

list_recommendations(session[, applied_only, ...])

List parameter recommendations

generate_recommendations(manager)

Generate new recommendations from discovered patterns

apply_recommendation(recommendation_id, session, manager)

Apply a recommendation by running a simulation with recommended parameters

async database.routers.experiment.create_experiment(request, manager)[source]

Create and run a new experiment

This will: 1. Create or use a baseline run 2. Run multiple test simulations with parameter changes 3. Analyze results 4. Generate conclusions

  • manager (database.dependencies.ManagerDep)
